response.text: {"summary": "This repository implements a simple TCP chat application using the standard library, consisting of a client, a server, and a shared protocol module. The `protocol.py` file defines the wire format, specifying UTF-8 text messages terminated by a newline and enforcing a maximum line length. The `server.py` module runs a multi-client TCP chat server where each client is handled on its own thread, and messages are broadcast to all other connected clients. The `client.py` module provides a TCP chat client that sends lines typed on stdin to the server and prints received messages. These components work together to enable real-time text communication between multiple users over a network."}
